test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The action of killing oneself intentionally
solution: The correct answer is '**Suicide**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Suicide**'. • It means 'the act or an instance of taking one's own life voluntarily and intentionally (स्वेच्छा से और जानबूझकर अपनी जान लेने की क्रिया या उदाहरण)'. • *Example: Authorities have officially ruled the death a **suicide**.* **Correct Sentence:__** *Suicide.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Parricide**: the killing of a parent or other near relative. (माता-पिता या अन्य निकट संबंधी की हत्या) • **Homicide**: the illegal killing of one person by another; murder. (एक व्‍यक्ति द्वारा दूसरे की ग़ैर-क़ानूनी हत्‍या; हत्‍या) • **Genocide**: the murder of all the people of a particular race, religion, etc. (विशेष प्रजाति, धर्म आदि के लोगों की सामूहिक हत्‍या; नरसंहार) 34:T9ac, The correct answer is '**Although**'.
